revision_budget: This is the initial P1344 contract. The protected authority manifest permits at most one contract revision after R1; no revision is consumed by this artifact.

normative_composition.binding: p1344-contract-binding-r1.json at the hash recorded by the authorship receipt
normative_composition.rule: Decode the exact P1343 FINAL R2 contract and binding first, then apply only replaced_p1343_clauses and the exact protected P1344 topology overlay. Every P1343 clause, production, row, value, order, cardinality, runtime obligation, forbidden binding and classification rule not explicitly replaced remains normative byte-semantically and cannot be reinterpreted. Missing, conflicting, stale or candidate-controlled composition is Violated.
replaced_p1343_clauses: All source/topology counts of 36 capsules in ten files become exactly 38 capsules in twelve files from the protected P1344 overlay.
P1343-FUNC-CARRIER-HELPERS helper_impl production becomes only cfg(p1339_observation) associated methods of Func inside the existing impl Func.
Content::p1343_observe_h11 moves to P1344-CONTENT-CARRIER-HELPERS inside the existing impl Content.
CounterUpdate::p1343_observe_h10 moves to P1344-COUNTER-UPDATE-CARRIER-HELPERS inside the existing impl CounterUpdate.
Whole-file inverse normalization and authority-root/checker pins use the exact P1344 twelve-file freeze, contract, binding and overlay hashes.
The independent Rust A/B artifact is reissued as P1344 after seal; the P1343 historical test is not acceptance evidence.
preserved_obligations: exact H00D,H00S,H01,H02,H03,H04,H05,H06,H07,H08,H09,H10,H11,H12A,H12B,H13,H14,H15,H16 row set and all nineteen row records
all P1342 event schemas, roles, typed values, spans, challenge and identity algebra
append-receipt formula, one append path, carrier continuity and exact Location
snapshot pre/post identity, immutable raw freeze before read-only projection
attempt-kind, R, hook_hit, applicable-row and per-mode cardinalities
late appends, ordering, H00D/H00S exclusivity and B01-B05
the full closed token/AST grammar for every inherited capsule except the one exact helper production replacement
the complete closed private carrier-ledger skeleton and facade/source-runtime evidence boundary
strict duplicate-key-free closed JSON, immutable checker/corpus/root authority and payload-only Unknown precedence

measured_cause_and_repair.cause: The protected P1343 helper capsule is physically inside impl Func, while FINAL R2 required nested inherent impl blocks for Func, Content and CounterUpdate; rustfmt rejected that grammar before any oracle case ran.
measured_cause_and_repair.repair: Keep only Func associated methods in the existing impl Func and add two separate owner-local associated-method capsules inside the already existing impl Content and impl CounterUpdate.
measured_cause_and_repair.parser_fit: The protected P1344 topology authority inserted one representative cfg-only associated method into each complete candidate-free owner source in /dev/shm and rustfmt parsed 3/3, with zero wrappers, impl close/reopen, nested/nonlocal impls or const/macro containers.
measured_cause_and_repair.semantic_delta: NONE: helper declaration ownership changes; the nineteen runtime rows and their runtime semantics do not.

l0_assessment.reason: The three internal cfg-only owner clauses were updated and resealed before this contract; V5/V15/V26 passed for twelve distinct 1:1 owners. This contract changes no public API, default behavior, compatibility or pipeline phase.

source_proof.responsibility: Prove exact protected hashes and closed schemas; real lexical marker identity and pairing; exact anchors; exact cfg AST; exact capsule grammar category; inverse replacement; twelve normalized whole-file hashes; resolved owner symbol/branch; inherited relative adjacency; and physical owner-local placement for Func, Content and CounterUpdate. It must not claim general semantic reachability, def-use, freshness, identity, callback count or runtime cardinality.
source_proof.parser: Tokenize Rust literals, comments and delimiters with the exact P1343 lexical rules, then parse every capsule body with a deterministic recursive-descent parser whose complete productions are the composed P1343 grammar plus the P1344 owner_associated_methods production. Every effective token, attribute, item, statement, expression and delimiter is consumed exactly once. Regex or substring matching may locate bytes but cannot accept or reject a production.
source_proof.direct_hooks: The exact twelve P1343 direct-hook insert productions and hook_call_contract records are preserved. Each is exactly Attr(cfg) plus one semicolon-terminated direct method call with exact receiver/method/argument grammar. Qualification, aliasing, comments/strings, macros, closures, items, branches, blocks and extra tokens are ungrammatical.
source_proof.replacements: The exact fourteen P1343 replace productions remain unchanged: nine and only nine expression-tail wrappers, four item replacements and one statement replacement. Every normal branch restores the decoded baseline bytes exactly and every observed branch executes the original operation exactly once.
source_proof.owner_local_helpers: P1343-FUNC-CARRIER-HELPERS, P1344-CONTENT-CARRIER-HELPERS and P1344-COUNTER-UPDATE-CARRIER-HELPERS are parsed as associated methods within their already-open inherent impl owners. Their owner entity, exact finite method set, cfg, visibility and effects are binding facts. Any nested/nonlocal impl, close/reopen, wrapper, const/macro container, trait, import/reexport indirection, method in the wrong entity or extra associated item is Violated.
source_proof.carrier: The exact P1343-FUNC-CARRIER-TYPES closed carrier_ledger_skeleton remains normative. Only the helper declaration locations change. No alternate storage, constructor, writer, mutable projection, raw Vec exposure, global/static side table or reconstruction is grammatical.
source_proof.inverse_normalization: Validate the composed 38-marker closed world, owners, exact anchors and manifest; process all 38 capsules in descending live byte offset; replace each complete marker region with its exact decoded replacement; require the twelve complete normalized file hashes from p1344-capsule-baseline-r1.json. Candidate ranges, aliases, DTO claims and self-declared hashes are untrusted.
source_proof.limits: The focal parser is not a Rust compiler, resolver, borrow checker, call-graph solver or macro expander. Unsupported or ambiguous tokens are Violated. rustfmt and cargo gates are independently mandatory.

runtime_proof.preservation: The exact complete P1343 FINAL R2 runtime_proof and its P1342 R2/R3 composition remain normative without reinterpretation.
runtime_proof.real_candidate_only: Candidate/final acceptance requires the independently compiled P1344 Rust A/B test and a canonical externally hashed runtime receipt created from real facade outputs. Source text, synthetic runtime, formatted references and candidate booleans cannot satisfy runtime proof.
runtime_proof.fresh_inputs: The test authority constructs three distinct World instances with verifier nonces, three separately parsed Source instances with distinct FileIds and exact 178-byte fixture bytes, and three unpredictable pairwise-distinct 32-byte challenges. It records pre-call witnesses, invokes the single-run facade once for normal, repeat and reverse, and requires pairwise-disjoint run/ledger/cell/carrier/content/location/snapshot/dict identities.
runtime_proof.causal_receipts: Each immutable raw snapshot comes directly from H16 before projection; its canonical digest is independently computed, projected read-only, and recomputed unchanged. Actual receipts must map to all nineteen rows and satisfy the exact append formula, hook_hit, H00D/H00S/R cardinalities, carrier, Location, snapshot and typed-value continuity.
runtime_proof.synthetic_boundary: Synthetic source trees and runtime are allowed only in the discriminatory oracle corpus. Candidate-root or final invocation with synthetic evidence, fixed formatted refs or a receipt not emitted by the frozen independent Rust test is Violated.

strict_artifact_io.json: All JSON inputs are UTF-8, duplicate-key-free at every object depth, finite-number-only and exact closed-schema before any field is used. Last-key-wins parsing is forbidden. Canonical output is RFC 8785 plus one trailing LF.
strict_artifact_io.source_evidence: Source evidence contains only protected pins, twelve file records, 38 capsule grammar records, nineteen structural row records, carrier-skeleton result, owner-local result and source-verifier provenance. It contains no semantic reached/fresh/cardinality claim; the checker independently rederives every source field.
strict_artifact_io.runtime_evidence: The runtime receipt path/hash is supplied by the independent Rust test/final verifier, rehashed before strict parse, and joined to source only by exact P1344 contract/binding/candidate file hashes plus exact hook/capsule/row identities.
strict_artifact_io.no_self_attestation: A result, parse_ok, reached, fresh, writer_unique, projection_read_only, owner_local or equivalent field is never evidence without independent recomputation or a real challenged receipt.

checker_authority.order: The oracle author emits the canonical closed P1344 corpus first, hashes it, then emits the checker with immutable literal EXPECTED_CORPUS_SHA256 and immutable exact P1344 step, manifest, contract, binding, overlay, L0 freeze, fixture and source-verifier hashes. No CLI/default path may change these literals.
checker_authority.invocation: Preseal/final authority receives expected checker/source-verifier/corpus hashes out of band, rehashes them before load, and recomputes the P1344 authority root. CLI paths locate bytes only and sibling hash files never establish trust.
checker_authority.corpus: The corpus strictly records exact composed pins, closed case order/budget/set and replays all valid P1343 cases and attacks plus owner-split cases. A self-consistent alternate corpus/digest/checker/root, duplicate-key input or changed order/case set is Violated before case execution.
checker_authority.root: Use exactly the authority_root_formula in the P1344 binding. Any missing compiled pin, checker hash drift or root mismatch is Violated.

precedence: 1. Verify immutable checker/root and every protected hash.
2. Strict-parse duplicate-key-free closed schemas and exact P1343/P1342 composition.
3. Validate marker pairing, exact anchors, inverse normalization and twelve whole-file hashes.
4. Parse all 38 bodies against the exact closed grammar and carrier skeleton; resolve exact owner and adjacency, including the three owner-local helper capsules.
5. For a real candidate, require rustfmt, observation cargo test --no-run, normal cargo build and independent P1344 A/B runtime receipt; synthetic corpus cases remain synthetic-only.
6. Validate the one raw append path, immutable snapshot/read-only projection and every composed P1342 causal/runtime predicate from actual challenged receipts.
7. Only after 1-6 pass may the single explicitly authored dict-witness payload opacity be Unknown; otherwise a valid inspectable case is Preserved.
classification.violated: Any earlier failure, missing proof, unsupported grammar, ambiguity, wrong owner, nested/nonlocal impl, dead/unreached hook, forged runtime, reuse, duplicate key, authority drift or synthetic-to-candidate substitution is Violated with the first deterministic reason code.
classification.unknown: Unknown is restricted to the one deliberate opaque dict-witness after all non-payload predicates pass. Scanner/parser limits, missing runtime, budget exhaustion, wrong owner and ambiguous identity are Violated, not Unknown.

gates.oracle_focal: Oracle authorship may run only the new owner-split/grammar/root/strict-JSON focal cases and boundary controls; it must run no full corpus.
gates.adversary: A separate adversary must replay all inherited valid attacks, including the sixteen P1343 R2 survivors, and add wrong-owner/nested-impl/reexport/duplicate/missing/normalization attacks. Any survivor blocks preseal.
gates.preseal: Only after focal agreement and zero adversarial survivors may an independent preseal authority execute exactly one complete corpus in normal, repeat and reverse orders with repetition/reordering/race controls. Mutation score must equal 1.0.
gates.candidate_runtime: Run the frozen independent P1344 Rust A/B test on fresh normal/repeat/reverse inputs and repeat GREEN three times as required by the step; classifications agree while challenges and identities remain fresh and disjoint.
gates.gate_separation: rustfmt proves parser/format acceptance; cargo proves Rust name/type/borrow resolution; source grammar proves finite capsule shape and owner placement; runtime proves reachability/freshness/cardinality. No gate substitutes for another.

causal_invalidation.rule: These immutable artifacts are mandatory attack history, never P1344 judging or sealing authority. Reissue all oracle artifacts against the exact P1344 hashes. Any post-seal drift of step, manifest, L0 freeze, baseline, contract, binding, source verifier, corpus or checker invalidates the seal from the first affected phase.

budget_and_stop.stop: Stop on a physically invalid owner production, surviving valid negative, positive regression, duplicate vector/cause twice, protected drift, score below 1.0, need for a thirteenth consumer, ADR-0127 surface, weakened negative or synthetic/candidate-authored authority. No waiver or Unknown conversion is permitted.

scope.claim: Only the focal P1342 binding through the exact composed P1344 38-capsule owner-local topology and real challenged runtime evidence.

forbidden_acceptance: Regex, keyword, suffix or substring matching as deciding proof of capsule grammar, owner, mutator closure, constructors, def-use or reachability.
Qualified or aliased hook call, comment/string hook literal, dead closure/function/branch, cfg macro split, macro expansion or extra direct-hook token.
Nested/nonlocal impl; closing/reopening an owner; wrapper; const/macro container; trait; import/reexport indirection; Content/CounterUpdate helper in func.rs; Func helper in either new owner.
Mutable raw field exposure, alternate writer/mutator/constructor, mutable projection, global/static side table, post-hoc literal/macro/formatter or reconstructed identity/Location.
World/Source/challenge/ledger/snapshot identity inferred from names, clones, formatted refs or candidate declarations.
Synthetic runtime accepted for candidate/final, or source structure treated as semantic execution.
Self-consistent alternate corpus/hash/checker/root, duplicate-key JSON or a CLI digest overriding EXPECTED_CORPUS_SHA256.
Any weakening of the exact P1343/P1342 semantics, the protected 38-capsule/twelve-file topology, L0 or an ADR-0127 surface.

closed_world.rule: Every contract, binding, source evidence, runtime receipt, corpus, authority-root, checker report and case object has exactly its declared keys, types, cardinalities and order. Duplicate or unknown keys and unknown enums are Violated.
